title: Pretty good app.
body:
It is a nice app with nice features but the UI, imo, could do with a more modern looking overhaul. Also, here are a few suggestive additions to make this app better:
• Add incline feature to treadmill option.
• Dark mode for night time (perhaps).
That’s pretty much all. 
Thanks.
